T: Kidnap the dog. Keep the cookies.
D: A fed-up chauffeur and his best mate kidnap his stingy cookie-baron boss's dog, and it goes wrong fast.
P: Serve the cookies when Willard and Rusty hatch the plan.
S: Prosciutto wrapped breadsticks with warm herbed olives and cheddar

Crisp breadsticks wrapped in prosciutto, served with marinated olives and cubes of aged cheddar, fancy snacks for the back of the limo. Wrap 12 grissini breadsticks with half a slice of prosciutto each, from 100g, spiralling it around the top half. Warm 200g mixed olives in a small pan with 2 tbsp olive oil, the zest of 1 orange, 1 crushed garlic clove and a sprig of rosemary for 3 minutes, then cool slightly. Cut 150g vintage cheddar into cubes. Stand the grissini in a tall glass and serve with the olives and cheese.
Chicken salted chips with onion gravy

Crisp chips with chicken salt and a jug of hot homemade beef gravy for pouring over, diner style. Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once, and toss with 2 tsp chicken salt while hot. Melt 30g butter in a small pan, add 1 finely chopped small onion and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour for 1 minute, then whisk in 400ml beef stock and 1 tsp Worcestershire and simmer 5 minutes. Strain into a jug. Serve the chips in a big basket with the gravy for pouring.
M: Pepperoni, ham, bacon and Italian sausage pizza on barbecue sauce

A loaded meat lovers pizza with smoky barbecue base, pepperoni, ham, bacon, Italian sausage and mozzarella, baked until crisp and blistered. Stretch 750g pizza dough into two 30cm rounds on oiled trays. Mix 100ml pizza sauce with 3 tbsp barbecue sauce and spread over the bases. Scatter with 300g grated mozzarella. Top with 100g pepperoni, 100g chopped ham, 3 rashers chopped bacon and 2 Italian sausages, squeezed from the skins in small pieces. Bake at 240C for 12 to 14 minutes until the crust is golden and the meat is crisp.
W: Chunky chocolate chip cookies baked soft
Big homemade chocolate chip cookies, the kind that built the Crock family fortune and made her so mean about sharing.
K: Vanilla ice cream, milk and crushed chocolate chip cookies blended thick

Thick vanilla milkshakes blended with crushed chocolate chip cookies, topped with whipped cream and a whole cookie on the rim. Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Blend 600ml cold full cream milk, 8 scoops vanilla ice cream and 6 crushed chocolate chip cookies until thick but still a little chunky. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and sprinkle with 2 more crushed cookies. Sit a whole cookie on the rim of each glass.
